refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Manager is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.Manager
type LogTarget( console, kmsg, journal, syslog, console_prefixed, journal_or_kmsg, syslog_or_kmsg, auto, null )
type OOMPolicy( continue, stop, kill )
type ExecOutputType( inherit, null, tty, kmsg, kmsg_console, journal, journal_console, socket, fd, file, append, truncate )
type CGroupPressureWatch( no, yes, auto, skip )
type EmergencyAction( none, exit, exit_force, reboot, reboot_force, reboot_immediate, poweroff, poweroff_force, poweroff_immediate, soft_reboot, soft_reboot_force, kexec, kexec_force, halt, halt_force, halt_immediate )
type ManagerContext( # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#LogColor= ShowStatus: bool, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#LogColor= LogLevel: LogLevelStruct, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#LogColor= LogTarget: LogTarget, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#ManagerEnvironment= Environment: ?[]string, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultStandardOutput= DefaultStandardOutput: ExecOutputType, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultStandardError= DefaultStandardError: ExecOutputType, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#ServiceWatchdogs= ServiceWatchdogs: bool, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultTimerAccuracySec= DefaultTimerAccuracyUSec: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultTimeoutStartSec= DefaultTimeoutStartUSec: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultTimeoutStopSec= DefaultTimeoutStopUSec: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultTimeoutAbortSec= DefaultTimeoutAbortUSec: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultDeviceTimeoutSec= DefaultDeviceTimeoutUSec: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultRestartSec= DefaultRestartUSec: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultStartLimit= DefaultStartLimit: ?RateLimit, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultIOAccounting= DefaultIOAccounting: bool, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultIPAccounting= DefaultIPAccounting: bool, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultMemoryAccounting= DefaultMemoryAccounting: bool, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultTasksAccounting= DefaultTasksAccounting: bool, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultLimitCPU= DefaultLimits: ResourceLimitTable, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultTasksMax= DefaultTasksMax: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultMemoryPressureThresholdUSec= DefaultMemoryPressureThresholdUSec: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultMemoryPressureWatch= DefaultMemoryPressureWatch: CGroupPressureWatch, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultCPUPressureThresholdUSec= DefaultCPUPressureThresholdUSec: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultCPUPressureWatch= DefaultCPUPressureWatch: CGroupPressureWatch, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultIOPressureThresholdUSec= DefaultIOPressureThresholdUSec: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultIOPressureWatch= DefaultIOPressureWatch: CGroupPressureWatch, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#RuntimeWatchdogSec= RuntimeWatchdogUSec: ?int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#RebootWatchdogSec= RebootWatchdogUSec: ?int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#KExecWatchdogSec= KExecWatchdogUSec: ?int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#RuntimeWatchdogPreSec= RuntimeWatchdogPreUSec: ?int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#RuntimeWatchdogPreGovernor= RuntimeWatchdogPreGovernor: ?string, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#WatchdogDevice= WatchdogDevice: ?string, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#TimerSlackNSec= TimerSlackNSec: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultOOMPolicy= DefaultOOMPolicy: OOMPolicy, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultOOMScoreAdjust= DefaultOOMScoreAdjust: int, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultRestrictSUIDSGID= DefaultRestrictSUIDSGID: bool, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#CtrlAltDelBurstAction= CtrlAltDelBurstAction: EmergencyAction, # The console on which systemd asks for confirmation when spawning processes ConfirmSpawn: ?string, # Root of the control group hierarchy that the manager is running in ControlGroup: ?string, # https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/262/systemd-system.conf.html#DefaultMemoryZSwapWriteback= DefaultMemoryZSwapWriteback: bool )
type ManagerRuntime( # The version string of the running systemd instance Version: string, # A short ID string describing the architecture the systemd instance is running on Architecture: string, # The features that have been enabled and disabled for this build Features: string, # An array of strings describing the taints applied to the running system Taints: ?[]string, # The unit search path UnitPath: []string, # A short ID string describing the virtualization technology the system runs in Virtualization: string, # A short ID string describing the confidential virtualization technology the system runs in ConfidentialVirtualization: string, # Timestamp when the firmware first began execution FirmwareTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the boot loader first began execution LoaderTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the kernel first began execution KernelTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the initrd first began execution InitRDTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the initrd first began execution UserspaceTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the system finished booting up FinishTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when shutdown began, i.e. when units started to be stopped ShutdownStartTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when all units finished stopping during shutdown ShutdownFinishTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the previous boot began stopping units, restored across a kexec-based live update PreviousShutdownStartTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the previous boot finished stopping units, restored across a kexec-based live update PreviousShutdownFinishTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when systemd-shutdown began execution during the previous boot, restored across a kexec-based live update PreviousShutdownLateStartTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when systemd-shutdown was about to kexec into the current kernel, restored across a kexec-based live update PreviousShutdownLateFinishTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager started uploading security policies to the kernel SecurityStartTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager finished uploading security policies to the kernel SecurityFinishTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager started executing generators GeneratorsStartTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager finished executing generators GeneratorsFinishTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager first started loading units UnitsLoadStartTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager first finished loading units UnitsLoadFinishTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager last started loading units UnitsLoadTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager started uploading security policies to the kernel in the initrd InitRDSecurityStartTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager finished uploading security policies to the kernel in the initrd InitRDSecurityFinishTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager started executing generators in the initrd InitRDGeneratorsStartTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager finished executing generators in the initrd InitRDGeneratorsFinishTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager first started loading units in the initrd InitRDUnitsLoadStartTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Timestamp when the manager first finished loading units in the initrd InitRDUnitsLoadFinishTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # The amount of unique unit names currently loaded NNames: int, # The amount of failed units NFailedUnits: int, # The amount of currently queued jobs NJobs: int, # The total amount of queued jobs NInstalledJobs: int, # The total amount of failed jobs NFailedJobs: int, # IDs of transactions that encountered ordering cycle TransactionsWithOrderingCycle: ?[]int, # Boot progress as a floating point value between 0.0 and 1.0 Progress: float, # Timestamp when the hardware watchdog was last pinged WatchdogLastPingTimestamp: ?Timestamp, # Current state of the system SystemState: string, # Exit code of the manager ExitCode: int, # Encodes how many soft-reboots were successfully completed SoftRebootsCount: int, # Encodes how many consecutive kexec reboots were successfully completed since the last full boot. Zero if the Live Update Orchestrator is not available. KExecsCount: int, # Number of successfully completed configuration reloads ReloadCount: int )
type Timestamp( # Timestamp in µs in the CLOCK_REALTIME clock (wallclock) realtime: ?int, # Timestamp in µs in the CLOCK_MONOTONIC clock monotonic: ?int )
type ResourceLimit( # The soft resource limit. RLIM_INFINITY is mapped to unset value soft: ?int, # The hard resource limit. RLIM_INFINITY is mapped to unset value hard: ?int )
type ResourceLimitTable( # See setrlimit(2) for details CPU: ?ResourceLimit, FSIZE: ?ResourceLimit, DATA: ?ResourceLimit, STACK: ?ResourceLimit, CORE: ?ResourceLimit, RSS: ?ResourceLimit, NOFILE: ?ResourceLimit, AS: ?ResourceLimit, NPROC: ?ResourceLimit, MEMLOCK: ?ResourceLimit, LOCKS: ?ResourceLimit, SIGPENDING: ?ResourceLimit, MSGQUEUE: ?ResourceLimit, NICE: ?ResourceLimit, RTPRIO: ?ResourceLimit, RTTIME: ?ResourceLimit )
type RateLimit( # The ratelimit interval intervalUSec: ?int, # The ratelimit burst burst: ?int )
type LogLevelStruct( # 'console' target log level console: string, # 'kmsg' target log level kmsg: string, # 'syslog' target log level syslog: string, # 'journal' target log level journal: string )
method Describe() -> ( # Configuration of the manager context: ManagerContext, # Runtime information of the manager runtime: ManagerRuntime )
# Reexecute the main manager process method Reexecute() -> ()
# Reload the manager configuration method Reload() -> ()
# Enqueue all marked jobs # [Supports 'more' flag] method EnqueueMarkedJobs() -> ( # Enqueued unit ID unitID: ?string, # ID of enqueued job (if successful) jobID: ?int, # Varlink error ID (on failure) error: ?string, # Job enqueue error message (on failure) errorMessage: ?string )
# Power off the system method PowerOff() -> ()
# Reboot the system method Reboot() -> ()
# Halt the system method Halt() -> ()
# Reboot the system via kexec method KExec() -> ()
# Soft-reboot the userspace method SoftReboot( # New root directory for the soft reboot root: ?string ) -> ()
error RateLimitReached()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Manager shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Manager.Describe '{}' invokes its Describe method.
